devices.name: Ultrasonic Clamp-On Water Meter AQMLWE01
devices.description: The water sensor clamp measures the flow and temperature in a water pipe using a "Time of Flight" measurement method and transmits the data wirelessly. Through an internal analysis of the flow, water leaks, and other anomalies are detected, and the owner is alerted. The device is clamped onto the outside of the water pipe without the need to interrupt the water supply. Its flexible design and innovative software allow it to be used on water pipes ranging from DN15 to DN40 (diameter 15…50 mm) with all available materials in the market, such as PEX, PEX AL, copper, PE, or steel. It meets all the requirements of the European Metering Directive (MID). With a footprint of only 60 mm above the water pipe and a length of 110 mm, the device is very slim and short, making it easy to install.

devices.name: Aqua-Scope Monitor AQSWIE02
devices.description: The Aqua-Scope Monitor detects water leaks and records the temperature, water pressure and with some version the water consumption. In combination with an Aqua-Scope remotely controlled shut-off valve, the system regularly searches for microleaks and shuts off the water if necessary. The user is then alerted via radio, both during such incidents and when pressure anomalies  are detected. An additional wired flood sensor can be connected directly to the device.

devices.name: Ball Valve Servo BVSLWE01
devices.description: The Aqua-Scope Ball Valve Servo consists of a patented motor coupling that fits with existing ball valves and converts them into smart water control devices. It can receive commands directly from a flood sensor, aqua-scope controller, or LoRaWAN® gateways.

devices.name: Flood Sensor FLOLWE01
devices.description: The Flood Sensor detects the presence of water on its exposed sensor pins and sends an alarm message wirelessly when triggered. In addition, the device will regularly report the ambient temperature and humidity and send an alarm when the readings exceed thresholds that can be set for both humidity and temperature. The device itself is designed to sit on the floor, where 3 brass telescopic pins can detect water on both hard floors (tiles) and soft carpets. The unit comes with a mounting bracket. It can be screwed or taped to the wall or floor. When the main sensor is in the bracket, a super-flat sensor pad connected by wire to the bracket is used to detect water. When an alarm is active, the unit emits a sound and a red LED flash. The device is powered by an internal CR123 battery that lasts approximately 5 years in normal operation.

devices.name: Gate Valve Servo KFRLWE01
devices.description: The motor drive for angled seat valves (KFR valves) or normal straight-seated shut-off valves allows for retrofitting existing and already installed shut-off valves into wirelessly controlled intelligent devices without interrupting the water supply or cutting into the water pipe. The motor is powered by a 12V power supply and is completely waterproof and dirt-resistant up to the power supply. An optional battery pack enables autonomous operation in places where no electricity is available. Various adapter rings and a sophisticated connection system enable the use of the motor on all modern valves from DN15 to DN32. With an additional water sensor that attaches directly to the device, the motor can be used for leak protection without further configuration. The servo motor is waterproof and can be used in humid, dirty, and outdoor environments.

devices.name: Water Pressure Sensor PRSWIE02
devices.description: The Aqua-Scope pressure sensor records the water pressure in the drinking water distribution or in the hot water heating system. The device consists of two parts:(1) The main housing for signal processing and wireless communication with a battery compartment. (2) The external sensor head, which is connected to the water pipe. The stainless steel sensor head features a silicon sensor suspended in silicone oil for highly accurate and low-noise pressure measurements. The pressure measurement range is between 1 to 10 bar. The sensor head is installed somewhere in the building at a 1/8-inch inspection opening or with a provided T-piece under any sink at the angle valve.

devices.name: LoRain Rain Gauge RANLWE01
devices.description: This rain sensor measures the amount of rainfall at its location using a tipping bucket mechanism, reporting the quantity within a 15-minute interval with an accuracy of 0.5 mm of water column and additionally provides the temperature. In the event of heavy rainfall exceeding 15 l/h, a heavy rain alarm is triggered promptly. Both the heavy rain threshold and the measurement interval are configurable. The sensor is powered by two AAA batteries. The supplied VARTA batteries allow for an approximate runtime of about 2 years. A low battery level is wirelessly reported, enabling the replacement of batteries before the device shuts down.

devices.name: Flood Sensor
devices.description: The Aqua-Scope Water Sensor has a built-in water sensor and a freeze sensor that detects water leaks and floods in critical areas. In addition to the built-in water sensor, it allows connecting an external second water detection probe. When the water is detected, an alarm is sent to a gateway using LoRaWAN® wireless protocol.

devices.name: Portenta Vision Shield LoRa®
devices.description: The Arduino Portenta Vision Shield LoRa® consists of a 320x320 pixels camera sensor and two onboard microphones for directional sound detection. It allows you to run embedded computer vision applications. The Vision Shield LoRa® has been designed to work with the Arduino Portenta H7.

devices.name: MKR WAN 1310
devices.description: The Arduino MKR WAN 1310 is a development board that provides a practical and cost-effective solution to add LoRaWAN® connectivity for projects requiring long-range, low-power wireless communication. Sensors and actuators can be connected to the board through the analog, digital, UART, SPI, and I2C pins. The MKR WAN 1310 comes complete with an ATECC508 secure element, a battery charger, 2MByte SPI Flash, and power consumption as low as 104 uA.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar (dnt-lw-ats) is a reliable and compact GNSS tracker with a water- and dust proof housing according to IP44. Through the built-in solar cell, self-sufficient operation is possible. The position determination can be done cyclically or motion-based. In addition, there are many configuration options through LoRaWAN® downlinks, like the motion sensitivity or the positioning interval. The average sleep mode current is below 10 µA.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches is the ideal solution for intelligent control of lights and other electrical loads in public buildings such as schools, industrial plants, government facilities, hotels, or offices. It can be deployed within existing infrastructure and offers remote control via downlinks or directly on the device using the mounted switch plate.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® distance sensor 1
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Distance Sensor 1 (dnt-lw-dis) is a robust LoRaWAN® device for measuring distances outdoors. With its measuring range of 4 to 360 cm, the easy-to-install housing and various configuration options it can be used for a wide range of applications.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® energy sensor interface
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® energy sensor intefrace (dnt-lw-esi) is a battery powered device to integrate smart meters into the LoRaWAN® network. It can collect data from electricity and gas meters with different sensors.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat (dnt-lw-eTRV) enables remote control of the room temperature. It features three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day. Because of very low energy consumption of only 3.8 uA, a battery life up to 5 years can be archived.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Radiator Thermostat Controllable
devices.description: The dnt® LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat Controllable (dnt-lw-eTRV-C) enables two ways to adjust the room temperature: directly on the device with the integrated buttons or remote control via Downlinks. It features an always-on e-paper display to show the current temperature settings, three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day, a window open detection to automatically reduce temperature and the possibility to perform a dynamic adaptive adjustment of the radiator. Because of very low energy consumption, a battery life up to 3 years can be archived.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface can detect the state of a window of a door (open/closed) via the integrated magnetometer or the contact interface. Besides an external reed contact, it is also possible to attach a glas-break sensor to the contact interface to use the device in security context.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat
devices.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat (dnt-lw-wth) controls the heating or air conditioning of the room. It measures the room temperature and humidity and shows it on the integrated Display. For automatic adjustment of the room temperature, the user can configure three profiles with each up to ten temperature changes a day. Other features are the window-open detection, a holiday mode, an energy-saving mode and various configuration options through LoRaWAN downlinks. Through our low power design, the device consumes only 45 uA in default mode, which results in a battery lifetime of up to 5 years.

devices.name: LoRIS-BM-TRX1 - Experimental platform for LoRaWAN
devices.description: The modular system of ELV Elektronik AG makes it possible to carry out LoRaWAN experiments. The basis is the ELV LoRaWAN Base, on which various application modules and power modules equipped with sensors can be attached. The integrated antenna and compact form factor allow experiments to be carried out flexibly. The required firmware is provided by ELV, but the programming adapter can also be used to execute your own code.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® Energy Sensing Interface
devices.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® Energy Meter Sensor Interface ELV-LW-ESI kit is an interface module that, in conjunction with a radio module (included in the kit), records the energy consumption directly on the electricity or gas meter and sends the determined data via LoRaWAN®. The flexible meter reading can be implemented conveniently  for many of the common electricity and gas consumption meters. Various sensors can be used to read out the meters, e.g. electricity meters with IEC or LED interface, Ferraris or gas meters. The sensors are available separately and can therefore be individually adapted to the application. The ELV-LW-ESI kit is continuously supplied via a USB-C socket and therefore does not require a battery change.

devices.name: LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 1
devices.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 1 is the second GNSS-based product in the LoRaWAN® family. Unlike the ELV track from our modular system, the ELV-LW-GPS1 is an optimized design without module character. The GPS tracker uses a GNSS module for position determination, the corresponding data is sent via the LoRaWAN® network. An integrated accelerometer is used to use motion or standstill as a trigger for positioning. Furthermore, a contact interface is installed, which can also trigger a determination of the current position via an external trigger. The device can be supplied in a wide voltage range of 5 to 40 V. Thanks to its compactness, the wide input voltage range and the various modes for position determination, the tracker can be used in many applications.

devices.name: R718DB - Wireless Vibration Sensor

devices.name: R718DB2 - Wireless 2-Gang Vibration Sensor Spring Type

devices.name: R718EA - Wireless Tilt Angle and Surface Temperature Sensor

devices.name: R718EB - Wireless Tilt Angle Sensor

devices.name: R718F - Wireless Reed Switch Open/Close Detection Sensor

devices.name: R718F2 - Wireless 2-Gang Reed Switch Open/Close Detection Sensor

It is based on SX1276 wireless communication module, and the communication is fully compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A).

devices.name: R718N360 - Wireless 3-Phase Current Meter Interface

devices.name: RBS301-TEMP-INT - Probeless Temperature Sensor

devices.name: RBS301-TILT - Low Precision Tilt Sensor
devices.description: The indoor tilt sensor uses an accelerometer to detect transitions between horizontal and vertical orientation, as well as reporting the angle of tilt. Applications include inclination monitoring, garage doors, pole lean detection, loading gates, and bay door orientation.

devices.name: RBS301-WAT - Indoor Water Detect Sensor (Probe)

devices.name: RBS01-WR1M - Indoor Water Detect Sensor (Rope)

devices.name: RBS305-ATH - Indoor Air Temperature & Humidity Sensor

devices.name: RBS306-420MA - 4-20mA Current Loop Sensor
devices.description: The 4-20mA Current Loop Sensor can measure the current from another device or sensor. It uses a 10-bit ADC to measure an analog value between 4 and 20mA with a 10uA resolution. The weather-proof enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use. The 4-20mA sensor can also be used as a bridge device to enable a wide variety of sensors with only a 4-20mA output.

devices.name: RBS306-ABM - Acceleration-based Movement Sensor

devices.name: RBS306-ATH-EXT - Outdoor Air Temperature & Humidity Sensor

devices.name: RBS306-CON - Dry Contact Sensor

devices.name: RBS306-MBHR - Maxbotix Ultrasonic Distance Sensor

devices.name: RBS306-TEMP-EXT - Outdoor External Temperature Probe

devices.name: RBS306-US10M - Ultrasonic Level Sensor
